answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. What survives to the umber is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Each submission hangs on the fable of a task receipt, and the meadow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
